SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Everyone else has accepted our relationship.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ayase, Saori, Kuroneko, Mom and Dad...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: They all gave us their blessings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: The only one left is you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
In that case, all the more reason for me not to 
accept it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I have to object... on everyone else's behalf as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Why are you being like that...?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: You've always been like that, since the past!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
You always, always, always, always interfered every 
single time...!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...It can't be helped if you think of me that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...I have no ill intentions, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I understand that!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Mana-chan is super nice! You always think about us 
the most!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
You put aside all of your own feelings and wishes, 
put yourself at a disadvantage all alone, working for 
the sake of everyone's happiness...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I already understand that!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But, still...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...I'm sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I like him! I like him, I like him, I 
like him, I like him... [font_size=33]I just like him![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I love my Onii-chan...  [font_size=33]I love 
Kyousuke!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I definitely won't regret it! If you think I'm lying, 
then just keep watching me from now onwards!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: *sigh*

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ahaha... Just as I thought, it's useless.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I understand how you two feel... the feelings of the 
people that accepted your relationship, and of the 
girls that decided to support you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
It's really unfair, isn't it...? Something like being 
unrelated by blood.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
It makes me think, "How frustrating. If only it 
weren't for this."

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...You'll accept our relationship?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: No way.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You can't persuade me that easily.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
This time, it's my turn to be the one that's bad at 
understanding, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Yup. Assuming that every single person will bless 
and support both of you...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You're not that naive, right?
......That's a lie.
Even if other people don't understand... I clearly do.
Even Kirino should have noticed.
After all, Manami has...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Manami, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...Don't say anything unnecessary.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
You're her boyfriend, aren't you? You have to give 
all that kindness to Kirino-chan.
Manami has always, always been our ally, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I'm probably not the only person that will get in 
your way, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: So, you have to protect Kirino-chan.

There was never a point where she was our enemy, 
that would never happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hehe, good.
At times she was like a mother.
And at other times she was like a grandmother.
Like a little sister, like an older sister.
Like a true part of our family... our childhood friend.
She always only thought about us...
While putting aside her own wants and needs...
But... we can't rely on her anymore from now on.
We have to stand up and walk forward on our own.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Please take care of Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...Thank you, Manami-san.
We cried.
The tears wouldn't stop.

We had now flown away from our home, which 
had always warmly welcomed us.

The day when the three of us can laugh together 
like in the past is surely... far in the future.

At a time after countless days and months have 
passed and piled up.
